0022600102.text: The Clippers (1-0, 1st in the Pacific, 2nd in the West) visit the Lakers (1-0, 2nd in the Pacific, 4th in the West), with both teams unbeaten so far and the Clippers 1-0 at home and yet to play on the road. Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) are out for the Clippers, while the Lakers' Adou Thiero (knee), Cameron Carr (oblique strain), and Collin Sexton (calf) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season and split their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the most recent meeting on February 20, 2026 in Los Angeles, a 125-122 Lakers win over the Clippers.
